hook_line: NO DOUBLE SOCIAL SECURITY IN THE UK

hook_stat.sub: UK posting window with no double social security payments

stats.label: NIC exemption for detached workers, up from 52 weeks
Visa application fee — visa costs still apply
Immigration Health Surcharge for up to 12 months

diaspora_bullets: Detached workers need an EPFO Certificate of Coverage
Workers who move on their own for a UK job pay NICs from day one
news_summary: Indian employees posted to the UK no longer pay social security twice under the Double Contributions Convention in force since July 15.
payoff: Detached workers now pay into one system — India's EPF.
